children: HeartSciences added disclosures to its merger proxy, including Fortitude valuation details, after receiving seven shareholder demand letters.
The letters alleged omissions about the proposed transaction; HeartSciences said the claims lack merit and no further disclosure was required.
Supplemental financial-advisor analysis showed an indicated Fortitude equity value range of $206.0 million to $428.2 million.
The added disclosures do not change the virtual shareholder meeting, scheduled for November 19, 2026.
The merger proxy says Fortitude's management and board for the combined company would be selected by Fortitude.
